rules: Do not preserve a classical placement if it creates an unsafe fire/egress condition.
Fuel-specific installation requirements must come from applicable standards/manufacturer/project design.
Commercial kitchen requires its own fire/exhaust profile; no universal residential shortcut.
Combustion products and cooking effluent require safe exhaust/ventilation design.
Ancient 煙火之害 is not used as quantitative evidence.
Do not block necessary ventilation merely to satisfy old 'avoid wind' language.
Potable water safety overrides historical well practices.
Adding lead to a well is MODERN_SAFETY_INVALID.
Well protection/contamination assessment is an environmental/health engineering matter.

COMMERCIAL_FOOD_SERVICE.note: Restaurant/industrial kitchen hygiene and exhaust/fire rules vary by project and are not fully encoded in Batch11.
